Source archives cover repository files at pinned commits; external dependencies, datasets, releases, and other assets require their own entries.
Six Wayback source ZIP captures failed raw retrieval and are not counted as working backups.
Internet Archive removed the source upload item after successful earlier checks. Its copies and report files are unavailable and excluded from working recovery plans.

Public GitHub forks preserve source commits when the upstream repository is deleted, but still depend on GitHub availability and policy. They do not include external model weights, release assets, issue threads or separate submodule files unless separately listed.
